text:
Alex R: quick note — UX & infra. small tenants are flooding the SLO card with p99/5m noise. thinking: surface per-tenant sample_rate + a soft quiet_window in the console so teams can tune without touching infra rules
Maya: yep. current sampling is global. console surface should include sample_rate, quiet_window_seconds, notify_budget_pct and a live preview of est alerts/hr + cost diff
Kevin: add a notify_priority slider (high/normal/low) that maps to routing tiers; also prefer stable rule_id so patches only change sample_rate not create new rules
Alex R: example compact payload from UI (pseudo inline): `slo=http.latency.p99; window=5m; expr=p99>800ms; sample_rate=0.2; quiet_window_s=1800; notify_budget_pct=70`
Jess: edge-case — deploy spikes. allow `bypass_quiet_for_rollout=true` tied to rollout metadata so on-deploy regressions still alert immediately
ops-bot: policy-sim(sample_rate=0.2, quiet_window_s=1800) -> est alerts/hr -46%, false_positive_rate -2.5% (2w sim)
Maya: UX preference: default to "balanced" preset (lenient/balanced/strict) with advanced toggle for explicit numbers. preview should show per-exposure_bucket impact for staged rollouts
Kevin: telemetry: emit `alert_fingerprint`, `used_sample_rate`, and `preview_snapshot_id` with events so we can backfill and correct metrics. include `exposure_bucket` tag
Jess: rollout plan: 1) console toggle + preview + dry-run API 2) internal beta 3) canary to 5-10% tenants by exposure_bucket 4) monitor alerts_per_tenant_hr, ack_time, escalation_rate
Alex R: action items: @Maya mock UI + preview (due EOD Thu); @Kevin spec API contract + compatibility shim (PR next Tue); @Jess define bypass semantics and tests (start Mon); @ops-bot run policy-sim across random tenants once API spec exists
Maya: will add last_preview_snapshot persistence so ops can repro pre-change state if needed
Jess: flagged a regulatory concern where quiet_window could hide PII-exfil patterns — will add an RFC checklist item and opt-out for exempt alert classes
Alex R: agree defaults should be conservative. advanced controls opt-in. opening RFC after mocks. thanks :thumbsup:
